messages.author: 129e07bdb789652f
messages.subject: could not find function
parts:
Hello, 

 This is my first attempt to use devtools and testthat.

I have a function numextract in my package. This works:

expect_that(numextract("aaaa36"), equals("36")) 

This works too:

test_that("numextract works", {
  expect_that(numextract("aaaa36"), equals("6")) 
}) 

Now I put the code above in a file in the inst/tests/testhat folder. I build the package and I run :

library(devtools)
test(system.file(package="pjttest"))

But then I get :

> test(system.file(package="pjttest"))
Testing pjttest
Loading required package: testthat
Loading pjttest
1

1. Error: numextract works -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
could not find function "numextract"
1: expect_that(numextract("aaaa36"), equals("6")) at test_numextract.R:2
2: condition(object)
3: compare(expected, actual, ...)
4: compare.character(expected, actual, ...)
5: identical(x, y)

Moreover, after doing this, the following problem occurs:

> library(pjttest)

> numextract

Error: object 'numextract' not found

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: could not find function
parts:
Hi Stephane,

test() is for interactive development use. Use test_package() to test
a loaded package, and test_check() to run the tests as part of R CMD
check.

Hadley
